description: This file defines API route handlers for managing restaurants, menus, and menu items in a food delivery backend. It utilizes FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and includes functions for CRUD operations, authorization checks, and querying the database with filters and pagination.

methods.name: bool _is_admin(user: User)
methods.description: Checks if the user has an admin role.

methods.name: Restaurant _get_restaurant_or_404(session: AsyncSession, restaurant_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a restaurant by UUID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: None _require_restaurant_manage_access( session: AsyncSession, restaurant: Restaurant, user: User )
methods.description: Verifies whether the user has permission to manage a specific restaurant, based on roles.

methods.name: Menu _get_menu_or_404(session: AsyncSession, menu_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a menu by UUID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: MenuItem _get_menu_item_or_404(session: AsyncSession, item_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a menu item by UUID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: MenuOut create_menu( restaurant_id: UUID, payload: MenuUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["restaurant_owner", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
